fees.source: https://lakesnowden.hocking.edu/camping (electric $35/day; the $30 is the non-electric primitive site, kept in fees.note)

values.note: First come, first served, with reservations accepted with advance payment up to six months ahead. Two-night minimum on holidays and major event weekends.
'Camping season runs Memorial Day through Labor Day. Subject to change.' Seasonal units out by Nov 1.

facilities.source: https://lakesnowden.hocking.edu/faqs (Hilltop hot showers and flush toilets, vault toilets elsewhere, running water throughout, dump $20/use)

hookups.source: https://lakesnowden.hocking.edu/faqs ("Campers are not permitted continuous hook-up to water hydrants")

summary: 125 sites, reservable, dump, showers confirmed; base moved $30->$35 (the $30 is primitive); FCFS, 6-month window, holiday minimum, season, water no at site added. Pin OK.
note: Public park owned by Hocking College on Lake Snowden, off US 50 at Albany, west of Athens. Beach, horse trails. Daily through seasonal stays. --Claude
